name: web-browser
description: LLM-driven web browsing agent: a goal-oriented loop where an LM Studio model (OpenAI-compatible) drives the Obscura stealth browser over CDP via a JSON action protocol — navigate, snapshot (markdown + numbered elements), look (screenshot for vision), click by element ref or coordinates, type, scroll, eval. Solves cookie walls and visual interstitials; answers the user's task with real page content.
use_when: completing research tasks on live websites via an autonomous LLM-driven browser

args.name: --task
args.description: Natural-language task the agent must answer using live pages.

args.name: --start-url
args.description: URL to begin at (agent navigates autonomously otherwise).

args.name: --max-steps
args.description: Max action turns before giving up.

args.name: --model
args.description: LM Studio model id for the agent loop.

args.name: --vision-model
args.description: Separate VL model for screenshots; equal to --model = inline vision.

args.name: --json
args.description: Emit {answer, steps, url, sources, model} JSON instead of bare answer.

env.AGENT_MODEL: Model for the agent loop. Default: qwen/qwen3-vl-8b
env.AGENT_VISION_MODEL: Vision model override; defaults to AGENT_MODEL
env.E2E_JUDGE_MODEL: Model for e2e.js 'judge' rubric validation. Default: qwen/qwen3-vl-8b
env.OBSCURA_BIN: Path to obscura binary. Default: vendor/obscura/obscura

stdout: The agent's answer (or JSON wrapper with --json).

exit_codes.1: agent failed / model error / browser error

e2e: node tests/web-browser/e2e.js [--only <id>] [--timeout 300] [--trace] [--report-dir dir] — validates answers via deterministic checks plus an optional LLM 'judge' rubric; writes full step traces, screenshots, and verdicts to tests/web-browser/reports/<timestamp>/
